## Figures from the Annual Report (10-K)

- **Net Earnings (Loss) (Year Ended December 31, 2014):** $338 million (Source: documents/report.md)

The return on total assets (ROA) is calculated as:

\[ \text{ROA} = \frac{\text{Net Earnings}}{\text{Total Assets}} \]

Using the figures from the annual report:

\[ \text{ROA} = \frac{338}{6,239} \approx 0.0542 \text{ or } 5.42\% \]

(Source: documents/report.md)
